verdict.rationale: The only on-point evidence is the SaaS tutorial list. It confirms Entra supports SAML/OIDC-based SSO and that apps not yet in the gallery can be onboarded, but through a request to add them to the gallery rather than self-service custom configuration. Remote access to internal resources without a VPN is mentioned, but nothing ties it to header-based SSO. missing for 10: documented non-gallery custom SAML app setup, custom OIDC app registration walkthrough, header-based SSO support, step-by-step walkthroughs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
